name: Luxury real estate cinematography
note: Starter suite. Prompts describe generic scenes only: no brand, no named real person, no claim about a specific property. Extend to 20+ prompts with the client-facing team before using results for a decision.
negative: morphing, warped geometry, distorted faces or hands, flicker, on-screen text, watermark, cartoon look

prompts.prompt: Smooth aerial drone approach to a contemporary white luxury villa with an infinity pool at dusk, warm interior lights on, palm trees, straight architectural lines, calm water, real estate film.

Slow steady dolly-in through a double-height living room with floor-to-ceiling windows, travertine floor, cream sofas, late afternoon sun casting long shadows, all vertical lines perfectly straight, luxury property video.
Slow pan across a marble kitchen island with brass fixtures, soft daylight, shallow depth of field, a bowl of lemons in the foreground, high-end interior design film.
Vertical crane-up along the glass facade of a residential tower at golden hour, sky reflected in the windows, ending on the rooftop terrace, architecture stays rigid and undistorted.
Gentle dolly-out from a hotel-style master bedroom toward a balcony overlooking the sea, sheer curtains moving slightly in the breeze, morning light, serene luxury resort film.
Slow orbit around an infinity pool on a terrace with loungers and a city skyline behind at blue hour, mirror-still water, warm underwater lights.
Steady forward tracking shot through a grand hotel lobby with a marble floor, a sculptural chandelier and symmetrical columns, warm ambient light, no people, architectural symmetry kept exact.
Slow tilt-up from a stone garden path lined with low lights to the entrance of a modern villa at night, wooden door, warm glow, landscaping detail.
